name: Etapp 12: Österbybruk / Österbybruks bruksmiljö to Risön

description.long: Roslagen rounds to ca 20 km; keep 19 km from Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen.

utilities: Mapped facilities on this section include toilet, water, rest area, fireplace, shelter, heritage, attraction, campsite.
waterSources: Use listed water rows as planning-grade refill information; seasonal access, non-potable warnings, and local signage override static data.
notes: Roslagen rounds to ca 20 km; keep 19 km from Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen.
Use Etapp 12 GPX as the official downloadable geometry for the section.
One GPX track and one segment; no large internal gaps found in iteration 1.
Do not blindly join adjacent raw GPX endpoints: Etapp 11 has an auxiliary segment and Etapp 13 GPX is stored Lövstabruk-to-Risön, reversed relative to the written walking direction.

Current Etapp 12 GPX is eastern-branch geometry after Vika. Official prose still treats western Stormon/Grillholmen as a valid branch, but that branch is absent from the primary GPX and should not be normal-imported until alternate branch geometry is supported.
Facility/safety warnings found in iteration 1: Vika pump has non-potable water; Risön water is seasonal May-October. Access metadata separately records that Risön has no bus access.

facilities.name: Gravfält vid Film
facilities.description: Cluster interpretation: official route text says the route passes a larger grave field with about 50 Iron Age graves after road 290. Fornsök confirms route-adjacent RAÄ Film 9:1/L1943:3137 and Film 34:1/L1943:3351 as grave fields, with nearby off-route Film 10:1/L1943:3269 making the count plausible. Coordinate is an approximate cluster marker, not a single RAÄ object centroid; keep medium confidence.
